messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The user needs to submit many files quickly before a reporting deadline.
  quote: That’d be great — I’ve got about twenty files to get in before the reserves report closes.
- problem: The platform has an issue that must be resolved before the upcoming year‑end claims surge.
  quote: We need this fixed before the year-end claims surge.
- problem: They need to update reserves quickly to meet an imminent reporting deadline.
  quote: That would be great — I need to get those reserves updated before the end of the week and the reporting deadline is looming.
- problem: The customer needs a fast fix because a reporting deadline is approaching.
  quote: We’ve got a reporting deadline next week, so getting this sorted quickly would really ease the pressure.
- problem: They need to implement the platform quickly before their peak season.
  quote: Perfect. Thanks again — we’re keen to get this live before our peak season.
